export.title: Export
export.note: The backup is encrypted with this password. Without it, nobody can restore it.
export.reposDetail: Memory, transcripts and files agents made
export.browserDetail: Signed-in sessions; much larger and more sensitive

restore.title: Restore
restore.note: Replaces everything in Godmode on your computer with the backup.
restore.confirmBody: Agents, automations, logins, 2FA codes, integrations and settings on your computer are replaced with the contents of {{file}}. Running tasks stop.
restore.doneBody: Unlock it with the Godmode password of the backup.

phones.title: Phones
phones.cutBody: This phone may lose its connection if it reaches your computer over Tailscale.
phones.gone: This phone is no longer paired
phones.name: Name
phones.fullAccessOnComputer: Full access is given in Godmode on your computer.
phones.dropBody: This phone goes back to what phones may do. Only your computer can give full access again.
phones.removeBody: The phone can't reach Godmode anymore until it is paired again.
phones.removeSelfBody: This phone disconnects from your computer and has to be paired again.

pair.title: Pair a phone
pair.locked: Confirm it's you to show the code
pair.scan: Scan with the Godmode app on the other phone.
pair.connectedBody: It can use Godmode now. Full access is given on your computer.

passwords.different: Choose a password different from the current one.
passwords.noRecovery: There is no recovery: if you forget it, only a backup brings your secrets back.
passwords.changedBody: Use the new password next time you unlock.
passwords.dashboardFooter: For the browser dashboard. Use a different one than your Godmode password.
passwords.dashboardSessions: Other signed-in dashboard sessions have to sign in again.

secrets.title: Default for new agents
secrets.fillDetail: Godmode types passwords and 2FA codes into the page. The AI never sees them.
secrets.revealDetail: The AI may read raw passwords and codes. Every reveal is audited.
secrets.agentsFooter: Giving an agent this access asks for your Godmode password.

web.title: Web dashboard
web.footer: Host, port and remote access apply after Godmode restarts.
web.remoteBody: Godmode accepts connections from other devices after a restart. Only do this behind a reverse proxy with TLS, and set a strong dashboard password first.
web.exposeBody: Only expose Godmode through a reverse proxy with TLS, with a strong dashboard password and allowed origins.
web.noPassword: No dashboard password is set yet.

license.removeEnforced: Godmode stops starting new work on this computer until a key is added again. Your subscription itself isn't changed.
license.removeFree: Your subscription itself isn't changed; you can add the key again any time.

calls.ownerFooter: With the country code. Leave it empty and agents never call you.
calls.invalidNumber: That isn't a phone number Godmode can call
calls.instructionsPlaceholder: You answer for Studio Berg, a hair salon in Hamburg. Take the caller's name, what they need and when they're free.

callSetup.keyApiTool: ElevenLabs key of an API tool
callSetup.label: Label
callSetup.needsTwilio: Add the Account SID and the Auth Token
callSetup.pinOn: Say it on a call and Godmode does what you ask, from any phone.
callSetup.pinOff: Calls from your number can only start work you still approve in the app.
callSetup.pinRemoveBody: Calls from your number can then start work again without a PIN.
callSetup.pinWeak: Too easy to guess. Pick another one.
callSetup.pinLocked: Locked until {{time}} after too many wrong tries. A new PIN unlocks it.

phonesExtra.takeBackBody: That phone goes back to what phones may do. Only your computer can give full access again.
